moments.title: The Hundred continues with midweek clashes
moments.blurb: The Hundred 100-ball cricket tournament has ongoing men's and women's matches today across the UK, including Welsh Fire in action.

source.l: The Hundred Official Site / Cricket World

angles.name: Today's Matches
angles.copy: Big hits and wickets are flying in The Hundred today! Catch the action as Manchester Super Giants face Welsh Fire, and Trent Rockets take on Birmingham Phoenix. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Focus
angles.copy: It's a huge day for Welsh Fire in The Hundred! They're battling the Manchester Super Giants at Old Trafford. Can they ignite their campaign today?

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day looms
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 season culminates in Finals Day at Lord's on Sunday, August 16th, with teams battling for men's and women's titles.

angles.name: Finals Anticipation
angles.copy: The countdown is on to The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's! Who do you think will lift the trophies this Sunday? The competition has been fierce!

angles.name: Road to Lord's
angles.copy: With Finals Day for The Hundred just around the corner, every match this week is crucial. Which team has impressed you most on their road to Lord's?

moments.title: Premier League pre-season in full swing
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are deep into their pre-season preparations and friendlies, ahead of the new season kicking off on August 21st.

angles.name: Pre-season buzz
angles.copy: New signings, fresh kits, and pre-season friendlies delivering goals! The Premier League is almost back. Which club are you most excited to see in action?

angles.name: Season Countdown
angles.copy: Just over two weeks until the Premier League kicks off! Are you ready for the return of top-flight football? Who's your pick for champions this year?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield between Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Cardiff hosts Shield
angles.copy: Principality Stadium in Cardiff will host the Community Shield this Sunday! Arsenal vs Manchester City – a huge curtain-raiser for the new season. Who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Welsh Football Fever
angles.copy: A massive match coming to Wales this weekend! The Community Shield lights up Cardiff as two giants clash. What an occasion for Welsh football fans!

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Geri Halliwell!
moments.blurb: Geri Halliwell, iconic 'Ginger Spice' from the Spice Girls, celebrates her 54th birthday tomorrow, August 6th.

angles.name: Girl Power Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the one and only Geri Halliwell turns 54! From Ginger Spice to solo chart-topper, she's a true icon. What's your favourite Geri moment or Spice Girls hit?

angles.name: Spice Girls Vibe
angles.copy: It's almost Geri Halliwell's birthday! Get ready to 'Spice Up Your Life' as Ginger Spice celebrates turning 54. We're blasting the 90s all day!

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Bruce Dickinson!
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden's legendary frontman, Bruce Dickinson, celebrates his 68th birthday on Friday, August 7th.

angles.name: Metal Legend
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Bruce Dickinson, the iconic voice of Iron Maiden, turns 68 this Friday. What's your go-to Maiden anthem?

angles.name: Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Pilot, fencer, author, and one of rock's greatest vocalists! Bruce Dickinson celebrates his birthday on Friday. A true multi-talented legend.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, The Edge!
moments.blurb: U2's distinctive guitarist, The Edge, celebrates his 65th birthday on Saturday, August 8th.

angles.name: U2 Guitar Legend
angles.copy: That unmistakable sound! The Edge, U2's incredible guitarist, turns 65 this Saturday. Which U2 riff or song defines his genius for you?

angles.name: Iconic Sound
angles.copy: Happy birthday to The Edge this Saturday! His innovative guitar work has shaped decades of rock music. We're celebrating with a U2 playlist!

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Joe Jackson!
moments.blurb: British new wave and jazz-pop artist Joe Jackson celebrates his 72nd birthday on Tuesday, August 11th.

angles.name: Steppin' Out for Joe
angles.copy: Is he really going out with him? Probably not, but Joe Jackson is celebrating his 72nd birthday this Tuesday! Time to 'Steppin' Out' with some classic tracks.

angles.name: New Wave King
angles.copy: From 'Look Sharp!' to 'Night and Day', Joe Jackson has delivered timeless hits. He turns 72 on Tuesday! What's your favourite album?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Mark Knopfler!
moments.blurb: Dire Straits frontman and acclaimed solo artist Mark Knopfler celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Money for Nothing! The legendary Mark Knopfler turns 77 this Wednesday. His unique guitar style defined Dire Straits and countless film scores.

angles.name: Dire Straits Icon
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to a prolific solo career, Mark Knopfler is a true music titan. Celebrating his 77th birthday this week!

moments.title: Hollywood Vampires hit Cardiff Castle
moments.blurb: Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp, and Joe Perry's supergroup, Hollywood Vampires, play Cardiff Castle on Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Supergroup descends
angles.copy: Hollywood Vampires - with Alice Cooper, Johnny Depp, and Joe Perry - are bringing their rock spectacle to Cardiff Castle this Friday! Who's ready for a night of legends?

angles.name: Cardiff Rocks
angles.copy: Cardiff Castle is hosting rock royalty this Friday as the Hollywood Vampires take the stage! Get ready for some serious guitar riffs and iconic vocals.

moments.title: Jimmy Eat World at Cardiff Castle
moments.blurb: Alt-rock favourites Jimmy Eat World play a sold-out show at Cardiff Castle on Saturday, August 15th, celebrating 25 years of 'Bleed American'.

angles.name: Bleed American Anniversary
angles.copy: Cardiff Castle is going full alt-rock this Saturday as Jimmy Eat World celebrate 25 years of 'Bleed American'! Who's got tickets to this sold-out show?

angles.name: Cardiff Alt-Rock
angles.copy: The Middle' of your week just got better knowing Jimmy Eat World are playing Cardiff Castle this weekend! A huge night for alt-rock fans in Wales.

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Joe Jonas!
moments.blurb: Jonas Brothers and DNCE frontman Joe Jonas celebrates his 37th birthday on Sunday, August 15th.

angles.name: Pop Heartthrob
angles.copy: Burning Up for Joe Jonas's birthday! The pop superstar turns 37 this Sunday. What's your favourite Jonas Brothers or DNCE track?

angles.name: Jonas Brother Turns 37
angles.copy: From Disney Channel to global pop sensation, Joe Jonas celebrates his 37th birthday on Sunday! We're celebrating all things Jonas today.
